reason: I'd pay for anything that actually gives me my evenings back, but 'AI co-workers' could just mean more drafts I have to rewrite at 11pm. I'd poke at the free plan first, and I wouldn't pay 99 € a month until I'd seen it answer my customers and post for me without me fixing everything.
objection: Will it really do the work, or will it just hand me drafts I still have to check and fix? And 50 credits on the free plan probably isn't enough to find out before I have to pay.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run on my own business in the demo: it answers real customer emails in my tone and schedules a month of Instagram and LinkedIn posts that I'd publish without editing.
